original_criteria.original_text: Existing Nuvio account is the only user login
No cross-account library or session leakage

children.scope: A1-A4 synthetic acceptance gate and nonempty browser fixtures
A6/A7 QR session publication and credential-bearing rendering safety
A5 Library pending-edit, snapshot-limit and concurrent-writer policy

criteria.result: Existing Nuvio email sign-in and the exposed QR entry path are synthetically dispositioned; live QR/device semantics remain under #120.

observations.assertion: The configured upstream password exchange is used, no second identity endpoint or persisted password is introduced, and account-local data is reset on identity change.
observations.result: Focused lifecycle tests pass at the tested source; this is a synthetic contract check, not a live provider claim.
observations.limitations: Synthetic only; does not prove deployed provider behavior or QR entry-path safety.

observations.command_or_observation: Owner-authorized read-only live browser run on the deployed preview; sign-in, reload persistence, independent-context profile equality and A-to-B separation were observed.
observations.assertion: An existing Nuvio account signs in through the configured upstream and the application does not create a second account identity.
observations.result: Scoped live sign-in and persistence checks passed; no library/add-on/history write or refresh evidence.
observations.limitations: Single Linux Chromium environment; third parties blocked; no measured token expiry, revocation, QR or new-data propagation.

observations.command_or_observation: node --test app/alpha/js/core/auth/qrLoginService.lifecycle.test.mjs and npx playwright test tests/browser/identity-qr.spec.mjs --project=chromium
observations.assertion: The QR entry path uses attempt ownership and common establishment; a cancelled/superseded exchange cannot set authenticated state, write an owner marker or navigate.
observations.result: 16 lifecycle tests and 5 actual-screen QR tests pass, including cancel/supersede during owner resolution and local QR rendering.
observations.limitations: Synthetic only; live QR consent/expiry/device remains #120. A cancelled attempt may leave an already-issued owner request in flight, but it cannot publish.

criteria.result: Synthetic built-app coverage now includes two profiles and nonempty add-on/watched/progress/Library data with exact account/profile routing. Live evidence still covers existing controls only, not new propagation.

observations.assertion: The bundled application pulls distinct nonempty add-on, watched-item, progress and Library keys for the exact signed-in account and selected profile, and a later synthetic backend mutation appears only in that account/profile.
observations.result: Nonempty profile-scoped fixture assertions pass with foreign keys absent; see the fixture-closure receipt for exact titles.
observations.limitations: Synthetic loopback fixture; not deployed sync, provider authorization, or real new-device propagation.

observations.deployment: loopback static candidate with live primary Nuvio API
observations.command_or_observation: Previously executed read-only local-candidate A/B hydration control.
observations.assertion: Distinct owners and existing nonempty add-on/watched/progress controls must be observed before any new-write claim.
observations.result: Existing controls matched; no new profile/add-on/history/progress mutation propagation was exercised, so the requirement remains unverified live.
observations.limitations: Existing-data controls only; single Linux Chromium environment; no mutation, measured refresh or device evidence.

criteria.result: Synthetic Save/reload/removal and delayed-response isolation cases remain useful, but a live post-removal nonempty switch failed before response headers and has no established root cause.

observations.assertion: Bundled B-to-A-to-B navigation retains only the current account's nonempty Library, a clean independent receiver reflects final-item removal on reload, and a held old response cannot publish after a switch.
observations.result: The existing nine synthetic browser cases plus the new nonempty profile-scoped controls pass at the tested source.
observations.limitations: Synthetic responses; cannot diagnose a live request failure or prove hosted server behavior.

observations.command_or_observation: Bounded read-mostly hosted B-to-A Library switch with owner-created nonempty items; no intended test-record mutation.
observations.assertion: After an ordinary sign-out and A sign-in, a new A-epoch Library pull returns A's exact nonempty set and no B-only set.
observations.result: A single nonempty B-to-A switch completed with distinct owners and matching A content.
observations.limitations: One switch only; both Libraries were nonempty but B-to-A-to-B reliability and app Save/removal were not established.

observations.command_or_observation: Hosted post-removal B-to-A switch attempt; Library and critical reads failed before response headers.
observations.assertion: The current session and nonempty Library must restore without foreign data after an owner removal.
observations.result: No successful new Library response completed before the deadline. No leak was observed, but the failure remains unexplained.
observations.limitations: Failure category was not established; a later read-only round trip passed but does not explain this failed run.

criteria.result: Existing refresh/rejection/expiry/coalescing/late-response controls remain green at the tested source; live measured refresh and revocation stay under A8.

observations.assertion: A rejected refresh cannot remain authenticated, a delayed old-session response cannot publish into a later session, and offline cached display is not presented as server-valid proof.
observations.result: Focused lifecycle and sync isolation tests pass at the tested source.
observations.limitations: Synthetic contract matrix only; no measured provider expiry or revocation.

criteria.gate_owner: CH3 executor design/characterization; owner if a backend contract is needed
criteria.result: Failed and legacy pending edits are preserved locally, but there is no retry/resolution UI and no established safe contract for the 1000-item snapshot limit or same-account concurrent writers.

observations.command_or_observation: Existing savedLibrary state/repository/service tests reviewed; CH3 characterization pending.
observations.assertion: A failed mutation must survive reload, a reconnect must not falsely report acknowledgement, and item 1001 or a competing newer edit must not be silently discarded.
observations.result: Existing tests cover pending preservation and clean-snapshot reconciliation, but the 1001-item limit and two-writer lost-update cases are not yet characterized.
observations.limitations: Current behavior is not presented as acceptance; broader offline/concurrent durability remains unsupported pending CH3.

criteria.gate_owner: CH2 executor; security owner for unresolved sensitive risk
criteria.result: Reproduced stale QR publication is fixed at the service publication boundary; screen navigation during a held exchange has no later side effect.

observations.assertion: A QR exchange that completes after signed-out cleanup and a later login must not overwrite the later session.
observations.result: The probe exited 1: staleExchangeAccepted and laterSessionOverwritten were true.
observations.limitations: Actual service module with mocked Fetch and synthetic storage; not a browser journey or live exploit.

observations.command_or_observation: node --test app/alpha/js/core/auth/qrLoginService.lifecycle.test.mjs; node scripts/qr-ownership-probe.mjs app/alpha/js --assert-safe; npx playwright test tests/browser/identity-qr.spec.mjs --project=chromium
observations.assertion: A delayed/cancelled QR exchange cannot publish tokens, owner state or navigation after a later session or a cancel; cancellation during owner resolution is checked before state publication.
observations.result: 16 lifecycle tests and 5 actual-screen tests pass; probe staleExchangeAccepted false; a later session is preserved across a stale establishment.
observations.limitations: Synthetic service/browser evidence only; already-issued remote/owner requests cannot be undone.

criteria.gate_owner: CH2 executor; owner for material security disposition
criteria.result: The third-party QR renderer and innerHTML image sink are removed; a finite destination policy and an explicit unavailable state are tested.

observations.command_or_observation: Threat-model review of reachable QR sources/sinks and the destination policy, recorded in docs/NUVIO_IDENTITY_CONTRACT.md.
observations.assertion: No credential-bearing QR content is sent to a third-party renderer, unsafe image markup is not constructed, and residual same-origin token risk is stated.
observations.result: The external renderer is removed, the finite destination policy is documented, and residual localStorage XSS risk is explicit.
observations.limitations: Not an XSS-proof application and not independent human review.

observations.assertion: A hostile quote/event-handler image URL is inert; the login URL is rendered locally; no external QR renderer is requested; a safe same-origin image also renders.
observations.result: 5 actual-screen browser tests pass with zero external renderer requests, including the local QR fallback.
observations.limitations: Synthetic same-origin image stand-in; no live QR display or device claim.

criteria.gate_owner: CH4 owner; executor only after explicit bounded authorization
criteria.result: Measured live refresh/rejection/revocation and QR device/consent observations have not been made. The owner paused further live-account work; no replacement synthetic evidence is accepted.

observations.command_or_observation: Existing read-only live sign-in/persistence evidence reviewed; no measured expiry, rejection, revocation or QR device observation exists.
observations.assertion: A live receipt must record the elapsed expiry boundary, refresh outcome and rejection behavior without decoding or exporting token payloads.
observations.result: Reload-only evidence is insufficient; the row remains unverified.
observations.limitations: No measured refresh/revocation; no QR consent/device observation.

observations.command_or_observation: Owner-pause review recorded in the continuity handoff and owner checklist.
observations.assertion: No live account probe, marker write, device test, credential read or revocation action may run under the present pause.
observations.result: Blocked on explicit bounded owner resumption or owner-provided sanitized observations.
observations.limitations: External permission gate; no executable live probe is authorized today.

closure.reason: A6/A7 are resolved synthetically and A1/A4 pass. Parent O1-O3 are still unmet: live new-data sync (A2), the unexplained live post-removal switch (A3), the Library pending/snapshot/concurrency policy (A5) and owner-gated live expiry/revocation/QR/device observations (A8).
